{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA rows (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue and count
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()
num_orders = len(df_loyal_completed)

# Print both to ground the evidence
print(f'Number of loyal, completed orders: {num_orders}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
